integrity: The claim is proved symbolically from a telescoping unilateral-shift construction. No numerical experiment, external certification, or inaccessible computation is used. Source comparisons distinguish the original general theorem from later Bessel-restricted structural results.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample disproves automatic norm convergence under the literal scalar bi-g-frame definition. It does not classify the weakest hypotheses ensuring convergence; simultaneous g-Bessel assumptions are proved only as a sufficient repair. Results with independent convergence or Bessel hypotheses are not challenged.
title: A Parseval bi-g-frame with a nonconvergent mixed operator series
